ms.report:
Dear Catalyst Review Team,
We are resubmitting the Proof of Achievement for Milestone 1 of DAO Codex: Open Governance for Cardano Innovators (Project 1300079).
The milestone required the preparation and publication of two editable governance templates:
・DAO Charter
・Community Proposal Matrix

Both templates are publicly accessible through the DAO Codex page hosted by Sparring:
DAO Codex: http://dao.sparring.io/
Deliverable 1: DAO Charter
The DAO Charter provides a customizable governance framework for DAOs operating within the Cardano ecosystem.
Link:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1tKGlLtlluqedmOiHYvSJ-7_EOS95ud_8/edit
The template covers the core areas required by the milestone, including:
・DAO nature, purpose, mission and whitepaper references
・Cardano as the designated blockchain
・Treasury management, access controls, transparency and community oversight
・DAO membership requirements, rights and responsibilities
・Internal governance bodies and allocation of decision-making authority
・Legal effects and governance hierarchy
・Community Guidelines and standards for transparency, collaboration and inclusivity
・Support for both unwrapped DAOs and DAOs operating through a legal wrapper

The document contains 11 articles and is publicly copyable, editable and exportable in .docx format.
Deliverable 2: Community Proposal Matrix
The Community Proposal Matrix establishes the framework for submitting, reviewing, voting on, executing and closing DAO proposals.
Link:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/12MvxO4TL1w70ekYcFLiXojyk8J5YbtaN/edit
The template covers:
・Proposal eligibility and minimum formal requirements
・Alignment with the DAO's purpose
・Community discussion and proposal review
・Voting mechanisms and quorum requirements
・Abstentions and voting periods
・Approval thresholds
・Proposal execution and closure

The document also includes a Proposal Type Matrix defining specific quorum, approval and execution requirements for different categories of DAO proposals.
Public
